summary.intent: Extract shared-write operations (upload, create folder, rename, delete, update file) from the web UI's useSharedNavigation hook into stateless SDK functions, add comprehensive tests, and refactor the web UI hooks to use the SDK as thin wrappers.
summary.outcome: A GSD quick task was planned and execution was spawned. The planner created a plan at .planning/quick/260327-2ab-extract-shared-write-operations-from-web/260327-2ab-PLAN.md and the executor agent was launched; final commit/completion status is not shown in the transcript.

repo: The SDK currently only supports the owner's perspective for share operations (shareFolder, revokeShare, reWrapForRecipients); the recipient's write path (upload, create subfolder, rename, delete, update) is entirely absent from the SDK and lives only in the web UI.

publishSharedFolderMetadata in useSharedNavigation.ts (~line 719) is the recipient-side counterpart to updateFolderMetadataAndPublish in sdk-core — encrypts metadata, uploads to IPFS, publishes IPNS using a re-wrapped key instead of the owner's key.
withRevocationGuard (~line 761) and isForbiddenError (~line 140) implement a revocation detection pattern (403 → read-only transition) that any SDK consumer doing shared writes will need.
The SDK's ShareCallbacks type uses 'file' | 'folder' but the web UI has expanded to 'file-ipns' | 'folder-ipns' — this type needs widening in the SDK.
uint8ToBase64 already exists in sdk-core as a utility — no need to add it again.
The 5 write handlers in useSharedNavigation are ~400 lines of framework-agnostic crypto/IPFS/IPNS logic tangled with React state (useState, useRef, useCallback).

code.finding: publishSharedFolderMetadata — recipient-side IPNS publish, equivalent to sdk-core's updateFolderMetadataAndPublish but uses re-wrapped IPNS key
withRevocationGuard — wraps write ops to detect 403 and transition to read-only; needed by any SDK shared-write consumer
isForbiddenError — helper used by withRevocationGuard to detect revocation
updateSharePermission — calls sharesControllerUpdatePermission; natural addition to SDK share module alongside createShare/revokeShare

workflow: The GSD quick workflow init tool outputs JSON that may be returned via @file: indirection — parse with: if [[ "$INIT" == @file:* ]]; then INIT=$(cat "${INIT#@file:}"); fi
Quick task IDs use YYMMDD-xxx format with 2s Base36 precision for the suffix.
For SDK extractions, the recommended pattern is a new stateless module (shared-write.ts) accepting explicit parameters instead of React state, letting web UI hooks become thin wrappers.

open_items: Verify executor completed successfully and commit hash was recorded in STATE.md.
Widen SDK ShareCallbacks type from 'file' | 'folder' to 'file-ipns' | 'folder-ipns' to match web UI expansion.
Bake the 'after any mutation, re-wrap for recipients' pattern into the SDK's write path (currently fire-and-forget in useFileOperations).
restoreIpnsKeyForDepth key-unwrapping logic could become an SDK helper — deferred because it's tied to navigation state.
E2E tests for the new shared-write SDK functions were called out as a goal but not confirmed as implemented.
